review.sourceReading: The source description labels this recording hǎochī (好吃), a male voice from Beijing, recorded 2006-10-29.
review.acousticInspection: Praat autocorrelation at 10 ms steps, 60–400 Hz: median F0 in successive 100 ms windows from 0.2 s is 114.1, 102.1, 98.8, 103.3 Hz. The first voiced region falls and remains low; the second voiced region is about 139–142 Hz. This supports the intended half-third-tone context but is not a phonetic transcription or a quality guarantee.
review.listening: Not performed. Source identification, decoding and acoustic inspection do not establish pronunciation naturalness by listening.
